item_short_desc: The Sparkie Fire Starter is a one-hand operated survival solution that generates sparks three times hotter than a normal match, even when wet! Simply press down on the thumb tab to produce fire-starting sparks.
description: The Sparkie Fire Starter is a one-hand operated survival solution that generates sparks three times hotter than a normal match. Simply press down on the thumb tab to produce fire-starting sparks. This lightweight flint fire starter features a reconfigured strike tab enclosure and spark bar, with a rubberized grip for maximum control. The striker is set to the perfect angle to achieve maximum sparks and is designed to work in adverse weather conditions.
